items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in a related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Previous experience a strength and conditioning intern at an NCAA institution.

Under close supervision of the Head Strength and Conditioning Coach, assist with the day-to-day operations of the Hickey Weight Room, with a primary responsibility of assisting with the Football Program as well as other ICA sports as needed. The individual will also be responsible for daily maintenance and cleaning of the Hickey Weight Room and stocking of supplies. The Strength and Conditioning Intern will participate in staff continuing education that includes but is not limited to presentations, group projects and article discussions.
Knowledge of computer database and word processing software.
Knowledge of athletic equipment to maintain safety and proper usage. Preferred Qualifications: Skills in Microsoft Office.
Knowledge of a variety of intercollegiate sports.
